title: Welsh National Wastewater Monitoring Programme
description: In September 2020, supported by the Welsh Government, the Welsh national wastewater monitoring programme began sampling wastewater from wastewater treatment works across Wales. Bringing together expertise from Cardiff University, Bangor University, Dwr Cymru Welsh Water (DCWW) and Public Health Wales (PHW), the purpose of the programme was to undertake wastewater-based epidemiology, covering several biological markers.
